tools.name: chromex_list
tools.description: List open browser pages with unique target ID prefixes. Run this first to get target IDs.

includeSensitive.description: Reveal sensitive URL values only in this live response

tools.name: chromex_launch
tools.description: Launch browser with remote debugging enabled. Supports headless, proxy, insecure certs, and custom Chrome flags.

browserPath.description: Explicit Chromium executable path. Also supported through CHROMEX_BROWSER_PATH.

pipe.description: Use a shared remote debugging pipe without approval modals

extensionTools.description: Enable Chrome unsafe extension debugging for extension tools

webMcp.description: Enable the experimental WebMCP browser feature

chromeArgs.description: Additional Chrome flags to pass through

tools.name: chromex_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose local Chromex browser/CDP connectivity, config paths, DevToolsActivePort discovery, and visible pages.

tools.name: chromex_open
tools.description: Open a new browser tab.

tools.name: chromex_close
tools.description: Close a browser tab.

tools.name: chromex_focus
tools.description: Activate/focus a browser tab.

tools.name: chromex_incognito
tools.description: Create isolated incognito context with separate cookies/storage. No browser relaunch needed.

url.description: URL to open in the incognito context

tools.name: chromex_stop
tools.description: Stop per-tab daemon(s). Without target, stops all.

target.description: Target ID prefix. Omit to stop all.

tools.name: chromex_sessions
tools.description: List named Chromex sessions managed by the CLI.

tools.name: chromex_show
tools.description: Create a local dashboard artifact for named Chromex sessions. Annotation mode also writes an annotation pack.

annotate.description: Write annotation pack alongside the dashboard

tools.name: chromex_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility tree snapshot. Returns incremental diff after first call (only changed nodes). Use refs=true to get @eN references for click/fill/hover. Use query to filter to matching nodes + ancestors (preserves hierarchy, slashes page output for large sites). Hints (help[]) are only emitted when refs=true because they rely on a fresh refMap.

query.description: Filter tree to nodes matching substring (case-insensitive) in role/name/value. Ancestors preserved so hierarchy is intact. @eN refs stay stable.

noHints.description: Skip contextual help[] suggestions in output

tools.name: chromex_html
tools.description: Get page HTML, optionally filtered by CSS selector.

tools.name: chromex_screenshot
tools.description: Take screenshot. Supports PNG/JPEG/WebP, full page, and element capture by @eN ref. Returns inline image + file path.

ref.description: Element ref @eN to capture (requires snap --refs first)

tools.name: chromex_network
tools.description: Network requests. Without requestId: list captured requests (status, method, URL). With requestId: full detail (headers, timing, response body).

requestId.description: Request ID for detail drill-down (from chromex_network listing)

url.description: Case-insensitive URL substring filter for list

status.description: Status filter: exact code, 4xx, >=400, success, error, or pending

resourceType.description: CDP resource type filter for list

failed.description: Only failed requests and HTTP errors

cursor.description: Cursor returned by a previous list response

bodyLimit.description: Maximum request or response body characters for detail (default: 2000)

includeSensitive.description: Reveal sensitive headers and URL values only in this response. Audit, stats, and evidence remain redacted.

tools.name: chromex_perf
tools.description: Core Web Vitals including INP, long tasks, long animation frames, layout shifts, navigation timing, CPU profiles, and heap allocation sampling.

filePath.description: Output path for cpu-stop or heap-sampling-stop

tools.name: chromex_console
tools.description: Console messages. Default: live capture for duration. "list": stored messages since daemon start. "detail": full message with stack trace.

duration.description: Capture duration in ms (default: 5000, for capture action)

query.description: Case-insensitive message substring filter for list

cursor.description: Cursor returned by a previous list response

includeSensitive.description: Reveal sensitive values only in this live response

tools.name: chromex_domsnapshot
tools.description: Structured DOM snapshot with bounding rects and optional computed styles.

tools.name: chromex_highlight
tools.description: Highlight DOM element with visual overlay, or clear highlight.

tools.name: chromex_locator
tools.description: Generate a stable locator for an element ref or CSS selector.

tools.name: chromex_evidence
tools.description: Create an evidence pack with screenshots, snapshots, HTML, console, network timeline, and local replay HTML.

label.description: Pack name for start/capture or mark label for mark/stop

tools.name: chromex_issues
tools.description: Collect and inspect Chromium Audits issues including CORS, CSP, cookies, deprecations, mixed content, accessibility, and form issues.

tools.name: chromex_inspect
tools.description: Inspect computed CSS, matched rules, event listeners, and box model for an element.

tools.name: chromex_diagnose
tools.description: Produce a prioritized runtime diagnosis from browser issues, failed requests, exceptions, console warnings, and performance counters.

tools.name: chromex_eval
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression in page context. Returns serialized result.

tools.name: chromex_evalraw
tools.description: Execute raw CDP command. Some methods blocked by security config.

tools.name: chromex_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to URL, back, forward, or reload. Returns snapshot with refs of the resulting page.
